concepts.name: paper-postcard-concept
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, close-up visual concept of a compact audio player component for a nostalgic digital letter website. It must look like a practical buildable web UI, with subtle tactile paper texture and restrained lo-fi styling. Landscape image; player occupies most of frame on a quiet blurred dusty sage scenic backdrop. Warm off-white paper, soft grain, faint fibers, gentle shadows, faded graphite labels, muted warm brown icons. Clear legible hierarchy. No extra panels, no device frame, no watermark. Exact music title 'Yellow', artist 'Coldplay', current time '1:32', duration '4:30'. Include obvious circular play/pause control, slim seek slider with modest round thumb, and speaker mute icon. Use a pause icon to show playing. Retain accessible-looking contrast. Direction 1: Paper postcard. A simple horizontal ivory postcard with softly rounded corners, fine deckled edge detail, tiny muted ochre stamp-like sun symbol in the upper right. Small uppercase 'NOW PLAYING' over the title and artist, ample breathing room. Play control left, title and artist middle, mute right. Thin sepia progress line below, elapsed and duration underneath. Elegant, calm, minimal. Subtle cream to pale ochre paper gradient.
